mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over a single month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 1 month but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as economic growth falters.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS decline over 2 months but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.0 index point over two months signals increased supply chain activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns as production capacity meets demand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises >1.0 index point over 2 months
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises >1.0 index point over 2 months but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns as consumer spending and business investment remain robust.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains below 4.0% but SPX posts negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth < 2.0% but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals monetary tightening and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as financial conditions deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) during a period of economic recession signals a potential misalignment between housing market activity and broader economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate a correction.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises >5.0% during recession but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.
